decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the commencement of the development hereby
granted, details of the means of foul water disposal shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority. The details so approved shall be implemented in full
before the development hereby permitted is first brought into
use.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site
except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to
Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public
holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning
Authority.

Condition : 5 - The permitted outbuilding shall not be begun until full
particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises
against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has
been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning
Authority and the development shall not be carried out
otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 6 - The windows in the new building shall be obscure glazed,
hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced
otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Alterations and reconstruction of existing outbuilding for use as toilet block (Planning & Listed Buliding Applications)
